Examine GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset and GLM5NextVisionBudget for finite positive rate checks, source-frame/decode-work bounds, cancellation and reservations for adversarial variable-rate clips. changelog.d/native-engine-output-control-refusal.md:3 and inference.md HEAD:1717-1726 describe a pre-reservation 400 instead of a provider-sickness 500, an availability improvement if enforced on both submit paths. Verify EngineV2Bridge+Submission.swift and error translation agree, including no reservation leak or breaker strike.
